verses.text: Then I stood on the sand of the seashore. I saw a beast coming up out of the sea. It had ten horns and seven heads, with ten crowns on its horns, and on its heads were names that insulted God.
The beast I saw looked like a leopard. Its feet were like a bear's feet, and its mouth was like a lion's mouth. The dragon gave the beast its power, its throne, and great authority.
One of the beast's heads looked as if it had been wounded to death, but the deadly wound was healed. The whole world was amazed and followed the beast.
People worshipped the dragon, because it had given its authority to the beast. They also worshipped the beast and said, "Who is like the beast? Who can fight against it?"
The beast was given a mouth to boast and to insult God. It was given authority to act for forty-two months.
It opened its mouth to insult God, to insult his name and the place where he lives, and those who live in heaven.
It was allowed to make war against God's holy people and to defeat them. And it was given authority over every tribe, people, language, and nation.
Everyone who lives on the earth will worship the beast, everyone whose name has not been written, since the world was made, in the book of life belonging to the Lamb who was killed.
Anyone who has ears should listen.

Anyone who is meant to be taken prisoner will be taken prisoner. Anyone who is meant to be killed with the sword will be killed with the sword. This is why God's holy people need patient endurance and faith.
Then I saw another beast coming up out of the earth. It had two horns like a lamb, but it spoke like a dragon.
It used all the authority of the first beast on its behalf. It made the earth and the people who live on it worship the first beast, whose deadly wound had been healed.
It did great miracles, even making fire come down from heaven to the earth while people watched.

Because of the miracles it was allowed to do for the first beast, it fooled the people who live on the earth. It told them to make a statue to honour the beast that was wounded by the sword and yet lived.
The second beast was allowed to give breath to the statue of the first beast, so that the statue could speak. It could have everyone killed who refused to worship the statue.
It forced everyone, small and great, rich and poor, free and slave, to receive a mark on their right hand or on their forehead.
No one could buy or sell anything unless he had this mark, which is the name of the beast or the number of its name.
This calls for wisdom. Anyone who understands should work out the number of the beast, because it is the number of a man. Its number is six hundred and sixty-six.
